name: cockpit
description: Everything for running long sessions in one install: turn-mode, ctx-bar, ctx-heavy, herdr-jump and cache-timer, plus /cockpit:orchestrate, process management for implementation skills: independent lanes run in parallel Herdr tabs (one worktree each) driven from your window, at the fewest tokens and least wall-clock time; and /cockpit:implement-with-herdr, which drives a spec's tickets to merged code at the lowest cost: each ticket on the cheapest model and effort that can do it, workers cleared between tickets and auto-compacting early. Four of the plugins need herdr; cache-timer does not.
